resources.string: Android is an open-source operating system developed by Google, primarily for mobile devices like smartphones and tablets. Based on the Linux kernel, Android offers a customizable user interface and supports millions of apps through the Google Play Store. It\'s the most widely used mobile OS globally, powering devices from various manufacturers such as Samsung, Xiaomi, and OnePlus. Android supports multitasking, voice assistance, notifications, and advanced hardware integration. Developers use Java or Kotlin to build Android apps. Frequent updates improve security and features. Its flexibility, affordability, and extensive app ecosystem make Android a popular choice for users and developers worldwide.
